title: alcea cretica
intro: Alcea cretica, commonly known as the Balkan hollyhock or Cretan hollyhock, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Alcea cretica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
